  "concepts": [
    {
      "id": "cpt_confidence_interval",
      "name": "confidence interval",
      "aliases": ["confidence intervals"],
      "description": "A range around an ACS estimate, constructed from the margin of error, within which the true population value is expected to fall at a stated confidence level.",
      "anchor": "given confidence interval",
      "location": "census-acs-general-handbook-2020#c0113"
    },
    {
      "id": "cpt_standard_error",
      "name": "standard error",
      "aliases": ["SE"],
      "description": "A measure of the variability of an estimate due to sampling, and the basis for calculating the margin of error.",
      "anchor": "A standard error (SE) measures",
      "location": "census-acs-general-handbook-2020#c0113"
    },
    {
      "id": "cpt_coefficient_of_variation",
      "name": "coefficient of variation",
      "aliases": ["CV", "coefficients of variation"],
      "description": "The ratio of the standard error of an estimate to the estimate itself, expressed as a percent; an indicator of the relative sampling error and reliability of an estimate.",
      "anchor": "A coefficient of variation (CV) measures",
      "location": "census-acs-general-handbook-2020#c0113"
    },
    {
      "id": "cpt_sampling_error",
      "name": "sampling error",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "The error in an estimate that arises because the estimate is derived from a sample rather than the full population.",
      "anchor": "take into account the sampling error",
      "location": "census-acs-general-handbook-2020#c0113"
    },
    {
      "id": "cpt_statistical_significance",
      "name": "Statistical significance",
      "aliases": ["statistical significance"],
      "description": "The condition in which an observed difference between estimates is supported by strong statistical evidence rather than attributable to chance from sampling.",
      "anchor": "Statistical significance means",
      "location": "census-acs-general-handbook-2020#c0113"
    },
    {
      "id": "cpt_moe",
      "name": "MOE",
      "aliases": ["margin of error", "MOEs"],
      "description": "The published margin of error of an ACS estimate, from which the standard error is derived by dividing by 1.645.",
      "anchor": "dividing the positive value of its MOE",
      "location": "census-acs-general-handbook-2020#c0113"
    }
